definition.name: Fresh private npm lifecycle with exact retained native products

steps.name: Check fixed source and public package identity controls
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install -r tools/requirements.lock
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_npm_private_replay tools.tests.test_npm_private_registry

steps.name: Retrieve original native products and companion capsules
Install the existing isolated compiler boundary
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Install the reviewed JavaScript compiler inputs
Capture fresh private packages and execute the signed offline lifecycle

with.name: npm-private-replay-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/npm-private-prepared/retrieval.json
${{ runner.temp }}/npm-private-dependencies/capture.json
${{ runner.temp }}/npm-private-dependencies/qualification.json
${{ runner.temp }}/npm-private-dependencies/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/npm-private-dependencies/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/npm-private-dependencies/build-*/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/npm-private-dependencies/build-*/component.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/npm-private-dependencies/build-*/logs/**
